question: The angle of elevation from a point on the ground, 120 m away from the foot of a tower, is 60°. Find the height of the tower.
solution:
**Given:**

Distance of point from basr if the building is 120 m.

Formula used :

tanθ = perpendicular/base 

 [IMAGE: https://storage-googleapis-com.cdn.ampproject.org/ii/AW/s/storage.googleapis.com/tb-img/production/21/02/Trigo%20-%20Angles%20and%20Radian.PNG] 

Calculations :

tan60° = perpendicular/Base 

⇒tan60° = perpendicular/120

⇒√3 = perpendicular/120

⇒perpendicular = 120√3

∴ The height of the building is 120√3 meters.
